q: Arif told us that he had waited an hour. (Change into direct speech.)
o: Arif said to us, “I waited an hour.”
Arif said to us, “I have been waiting an hour.”
Arif said to us, “I had to wait an hour.”
Arif told to us, “I have waited an hour.”
e: Indirect-এ told us থাকলে direct-এ said to us বসে। Indirect-এর past perfect (had waited) direct-এ ফেরে past indefinite-এ (waited), সাথে he হয় I। তাই “Arif said to us, ‘I waited an hour.’” সঠিক। “Told to us” ভুল, কারণ told-এর আগে-পরে to বসে না। Had to wait মানে ‘অপেক্ষা করতে বাধ্য হয়েছিল’, অর্থ আলাদা।

q: Change the narration: I said to him, “You should give up smoking.”
o: I asked him to give up smoking
I advised him to give up smoking
I said he should give up smoking
I said smoking should be given up
e: “You should ...” পরামর্শ দেয়, তাই indirect-এ reporting verb হয় advised, তারপর object ও to-infinitive: advised him to give up। সঠিক রূপ: I advised him to give up smoking (আমি তাকে ধূমপান ছাড়তে পরামর্শ দিলাম)। Asked সাধারণ অনুরোধ বোঝায়, আর ‘said he should’ বা passive রূপে পরামর্শের সরাসরি ভাব কমে যায়।

q: You said to me, 'you do not do your duty.' Make indirect speech-
o: You told me that I do not my duty.
You said to me that I do not do my duty.
You said to me that I do not do my duty.
You told me that I did not do my duty.
e: Said to-এর পরে object থাকায় indirect-এ said to বদলে told হয়, তাই You told me। উক্তির ভেতরের you শ্রোতা me-কে বোঝায়, তাই indirect-এ I হয়, আর your হয় my। Reporting verb অতীত বলে do not do থেকে did not do হয়। তাই রূপ You told me that I did not do my duty। ক-তে do বাদ পড়ায় ও tense না বদলানোয় ভুল। খ ও গ-তে said to থেকে গেছে এবং tense বদলায়নি। Assertive বাক্যে said to থেকে told হয়, আর প্রশ্নবাচকে asked, অনুরোধে requested বসে।

q: You said to me, "would you help me, please?" (Make it indirect.)
o: You said to me, would you help me.
You said to me, you would help me.
You said to me if I would help me.
You asked me if I would help you kindly.
e: Request বা yes/no প্রশ্নকে indirect করতে said to বদলে asked বসে এবং if বা whether আসে। 'please' বদলে kindly বসে অনুরোধের ভাব ধরে রাখে। Person বদলে you (শ্রোতা me) হয় I, আর me হয় you। উত্তর 'You asked me if I would help you kindly.'। অর্থ: আপনি আমাকে জিজ্ঞেস করলেন আমি দয়া করে সাহায্য করব কি না। অন্য অপশনগুলোতে প্রশ্ন বিবৃতিতে পরিণত হয়েছে বা person ভুল আছে।

q: When I asked him ___ the keys, Bob said he had no idea where they were
o: if did he see
if he had seen
could he see
that he had seen
e: Indirect বা embedded প্রশ্নে সাধারণ বাক্যের শব্দক্রম (subject + verb) থাকে, তাই if did he see ভুল। Yes/no প্রশ্ন বোঝাতে if বসে, আর asked অতীত বলে আগের ঘটনা হিসেবে had seen আসে। অর্থ: আমি যখন তাকে জিজ্ঞেস করলাম সে চাবিগুলো দেখেছে কিনা, বব বলল সেগুলো কোথায় আছে সে জানে না। That এখানে বসে না, কারণ প্রশ্নের অর্থে if বা whether দরকার।

q: Nasima said, "What a fine picture it is!" এর Indirect speech হচ্ছে-
o: Nasima said that it is a very fine picture.
Nasima exclaimed that it was a very fine picture.
Nasima exclaimed that it is a very fine picture.
Nasima exclaimed that what a fine picture it was.
e: Exclamatory বাক্যে said বদলে exclaimed হয়, What a বদলে very বসে এবং is বদলে was হয়।

q: সহজ নিয়ম : Anwar said, 'I have done the sum.' বাক্যটির indirect speech হবে __
o: Anwar said that I have done the sum.
Anwar said that I had done the sum.
Anwar said that he had done the sum.
Anwar said that he has done the sum.
e: Reporting verb past হলে present perfect (have done) হয়ে যায় past perfect (had done), আর first person 'I' কর্তা অনুযায়ী 'he' হয়। তাই Anwar said that he had done the sum।
s: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, প্রাক-প্রাথমিক সহকারী শিক্ষক (শীতলক্ষ্যা) (২০১৩)

q: He said that ___
o: he will not come at five
he may not come at five
he could not come at five
he cannot come at five
e: Said অতীত, তাই পরের clause-এর modal অতীত রূপে বসে। Cannot-এর অতীত রূপ could not, তাই he could not come at five সঠিক। অর্থ: সে বলল সে পাঁচটায় আসতে পারবে না। Will not, may not ও cannot বর্তমান রূপ, যা অতীত main verb-এর সাথে sequence of tense-এ মেলে না। নিয়ম: said-এর পরে will→would, can→could, may→might।

q: He said, “What a pity!” বাক্যের indirect speech হচ্ছে -
o: He said that it was a great pity
He exclaimed that it is great pity
He exclaimed that it was a great pity
He said that it is great pity
e: What a pity! একটি exclamatory বাক্য, তাই indirect-এ said বদলে exclaimed হয় এবং that বসে। What a দিয়ে প্রকাশিত তীব্রতা বোঝাতে great যোগ হয়, আর অসম্পূর্ণ বিস্ময়সূচক বাক্যটিকে it was দিয়ে পূর্ণ বিবৃতি করা হয়। তাই রূপ He exclaimed that it was a great pity। ক-তে said থাকায় বিস্ময়ের ভাব হারিয়েছে। খ ও ঘ-তে is না বদলানোয় tense-এর নিয়ম ভেঙেছে, আর a-ও বাদ পড়েছে। Alas, Hurrah ধরনের interjection-এ indirect-এ exclaimed with sorrow বা exclaimed with joy বসে।

q: He asked me where I came from. The direct speech is:
o: He said to me, “Where do you come from?”
He asked me, “Where are you from?”
He said to me, “Where do you come?”
He said to me, “Where you come from?”
e: Indirect-এর past indefinite (came) direct-এ ফিরলে present indefinite (do you come) হয়, আর I হয় you। প্রশ্নের ক্রম ফিরে আসে: Where do you come from? তাই “He said to me, ‘Where do you come from?’” সঠিক। ‘Where do you come?’ এ from বাদ পড়েছে, আর ‘Where you come from?’ প্রশ্নের ক্রমে নেই। দ্বিতীয় অপশনে মূল বাক্যের গঠন বদলে গেছে।

q: Which of the following is the correct indirect form of the given direct speech: ‘How long will you carry me’? He said to me.
o: He asked me how long he will carry me.
He asked me how long I would carry him.
He asked me how long would he carry me.
He asked me how long he should carry me.
e:
Wh-প্রশ্নকে Indirect speech-এ নিলে said to বদলে asked হয়, প্রশ্নবোধক শব্দ (how long) রেখে বাক্যটি assertive ক্রমে (subject + verb) সাজাতে হয়। Reporting verb অতীত কালে থাকায় will হয়ে যায় would, আর you বদলে I এবং me বদলে him হয়। তাই উত্তর He asked me how long I would carry him.
মনে রাখুন: Indirect speech-এ প্রশ্নচিহ্ন থাকে না এবং auxiliary verb subject-এর আগে বসে না।

q: I said to the boy, 'Are you Akib'?- The indirect form of this sentence is —
o: I said to the boy if he is Akib.
I asked the boy that he was Akib.
I asked the boy if he was Akib.
I told the boy if he was Akib.

q: Choose indirect speech of the following: The stranger said to me, "Could you help me?"
o: The stranger asked me if I could help him
The stranger said to me if I could help him.
The stranger asked me if I might help him
The stranger told me to help him.

q: You said to me, "Why were you absent?" (Make it indirect speech)
o: You asked me why I had been absent.
You told me why I had been absent.
You asked me why had I been absent.
You told me why had I been absent.

q: Hello, Bashir, I didn’t expect to see you today. Sharmin said you ___ ill
o: are
were
was
should be
e: Said অতীত, তাই Indirect Speech-এ পরের অংশ এক ধাপ পিছিয়ে যায়: are → were। You-এর সাথে were বসে, was নয়। অর্থ: আজ তোমাকে দেখব আশা করিনি, শারমিন বলেছিল তুমি অসুস্থ। Are বর্তমান রূপ, was একবচনের subject-এর জন্য, আর should be অর্থ বদলে দেয়। Be verb-এর past: I/he/she/it was, you/we/they were।

q: He said, “Poor fellow! How changed you are.” The indirect speech of the sentence is:
o: He exclaimed in surprise that he was greatly changed
He pitied that he was a poor fellow
He pitied the poor fellow and surprised that he was greatly changed
He pitied the man and exclaimed that he was greatly changed
e: বাক্যে দুটি আবেগ আছে: “Poor fellow!” করুণা, আর “How changed you are!” বিস্ময়। করুণা বোঝাতে indirect-এ pitied the man ব্যবহার হয়, আর বিস্ময়ের অংশ হয় exclaimed that he was greatly changed (are বদলে was, you বদলে he)। দুটি অংশ and দিয়ে জুড়ে সঠিক রূপ পাওয়া যায়। অন্য অপশনে একটি আবেগ বাদ পড়েছে বা ‘surprised that’ ভুল গঠন আছে।

q: Change the narration: You said, ‘He was there’.
o: You said that he had been here
You said that he was there
You said that he had there
You said that he is there

q: Rafiq called me a liar. Make it direct speech.
o: Rafiq said to me, “You were a liar.”
Rafiq says to me, “You are a liar.”
Rafiq told me, “You are a liar.”
Rafiq said to me, “You are a liar.”
e: Called someone a liar বাক্যের direct রূপ হয় said to + person, “You are a liar.” Me হয় you, এবং এই গালিটি বর্তমানের প্রকৃত অভিযোগ বলে are বসে। তাই “Rafiq said to me, ‘You are a liar.’” সঠিক। Were বসালে কাল পাল্টে যায়, says বসালে reporting verb-ই বদলে যায়, আর ‘told me’ এর পরে সরাসরি উদ্ধৃতি দেওয়া রীতিবিরুদ্ধ।

q: Navid told Sumon that he (go) to Khulna the next day.
o: went
had gone
will go
would go
e:
বাক্যটি Indirect Speech-এ লেখা, আর এর reporting verb told অতীত কালে আছে। Direct Speech-এ নাভিদ নিশ্চয়ই বলেছিল 'I will go to Khulna tomorrow'। Reporting verb past হলে reported speech-এর will বদলে would হয় এবং tomorrow বদলে the next day হয়, তাই বাক্যটি দাঁড়ায় Navid told Sumon that he would go to Khulna the next day।
মনে রাখুন: একইভাবে today → that day, yesterday → the previous day, now → then হয়ে যায়।

q: He said, “I am busy.”- correct indirect speech is:
o: He said that he was busy.
He said he was busy.
He said he is buysy.
He said that he is busy.
